question: What is the minimum age to become a member of Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**30**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 80** of the Indian Constitution, the minimum age to become a member of the **Rajya Sabha is 30 years.**
 
• The Rajya Sabha is composed of a **maximum of 250 members,** of which **238 are elected by the Legislative Assemblies** of the States and Union territories, and **12 are appointed by the President **of India.
 
• Members of the Rajya Sabha serve a term of six years, with **one-third of the members retiring every two years**, ensuring continuity in the house.
 
• Besides age, candidates must be citizens of India and should not be disqualified under any law made by Parliament, as outlined in **Article 84 of the Constitution.**
 
• The Rajya Sabha plays a crucial role in representing the states and union territories at the national level, contributing to the legislative process, and reviewing legislation passed by the Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lok Sabha**

 
 
• The minimum age to become a member of the **Lok Sabha is 25 years**, as per **Article 84 **of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Lok Sabha consists of 545 members, with 543 elected by the public and 2 appointed by the President (though the latter provision has been abolished).
 
• Members serve a term of** five years,** unless the house is dissolved earlier.
 
• Candidates must be Indian citizens and not disqualified under any law, as specified in **Article 102.**
 
 
 
• **President and Vice President**
 
 
• According to **Article 58** of the Indian Constitution, the minimum age to become the President of India is** 35 years.**
 
• To be eligible for the presidency, a** candidate must be a citizen of India**, he candidate must be eligible to be a member of either the Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha, and must not hold any office of profit under the Government, as stated in Article 58.
 
• As per** Article 66, the minimum age to become the Vice President of India is also 35 years**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Panchayat (local self-government) in India**:

 
 
• The minimum age to contest in** Panchayat elections is 21 years**, as specified in **Article 243F** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Panchayati Raj system is a three-tier system of local self-government in rural areas, consisting of the **Gram Panchayat (village level), Panchayat Samiti (block level), and Zilla Parishad (district level).**
 
• The specific rules and regulations governing Panchayat elections, including age and eligibility criteria, may vary slightly from** state to state, **as each state has the authority to enact its own Panchayat laws.
